# Passing data-id from button to Bootstrap Modal You have a link that triggers a Bootstrap modal and carries an ID attribute, but you also want to capture that same data when the inner button is clicked. The HTML structure shows this: ```html ``` Inside the modal, you have a hidden input that must receive the ID: ```html
``` Your current jQuery attaches the handler to the outer `` element: ```javascript $(document).on("click", ".passingID", function () { var ids = $(this).data('id'); $(".modal-body #idkl").val(ids); }); ``` This works, but only if you understand what happens in the DOM and how Bootstrap handles events. The `` tag is not strictly necessary for Bootstrapâs modal trigger; the `data-toggle="modal"` attribute can live on the button itself. Keeping it on the anchor means the click event bubbles from the button to the link, and your handler intercepts it before Bootstrap processes the toggle. If you move the attributes directly onto the button: ```html ``` You can simplify the event binding by attaching it directly to the button: ```javascript $(document).on("click", ".btn[data-id]", function (e) { var ids = $(this).data('id'); $("#editkaryawan .modal-body #idkl").val(ids); }); ``` This avoids relying on event bubbling from a parent anchor and makes the selector explicit.
